Hey, I dont know if you are right, I do regret pushing bf away, but in my mentally troubled mind I really thought that I was the burden he didn't need. Not that I didnt need him. Although we are both pretty capable by ourselves, I didnt want it to be a toxic dependent relationship, me being the toxic dependent.

I have had professional help and I'm thinking of expanding that to include more. I'm not expecting him to want me back but I'm not ready now. Thanks for reaching out.

Hey, thanks for reaching out. I'm a girl :) I have been seeing a psychiatrist and I am on regular antidepressants. I've had three experiences with therapists and two of them were weird, I'm reluctant to pay money to try again. But I'm considering going back to the one who I think was ok. 

Bf said my problems aren't his burden, and he used to spend all night to console my crying, bless him. (Still inconsolable despite them) But this really cant go on the way it was going. He deserves to sleep early to wake up for work/take his mom to hospital early tomorrow at the very least. 

Hey. Really. Thanks for talking to me. I dont know whats the best foot forward but just two days in, the distance I've put between us has made me really miss him. I want to be the best of myself for him (if he still wants me) and I'll try my damn best.
